issues.problem: sae-ba explain gave 見ていてさえくれれば as the て-form pattern, which is malformed; the standard forms are Vてさえいれば / Vてさえくれれば.
issues.action: Replaced with 見てさえいれば, 来てさえくれれば; used 読みさえすれば as the masu-stem example.

issues.problem: sae-ba explain and mistake note implied a する verb must take the masu stem (練習しさえすれば), but 練習さえすれば (noun + さえ + すれば) is equally standard; following the rule mechanically would mark a correct form wrong.
issues.action: Added that 練習さえすれば is also correct, in both explain and the mistake note.

issues.problem: explain said まで simply replaces が, missing the common subject form までが (弟までが来た).
issues.action: Added a parenthetical noting までが.

issues.problem: Mistake note said まで adds an extra 'in an affirmative', which overstates things: まで also appears with negatives (友達まで信じてくれなかった).
issues.action: Reworded: まで adds an unexpected extra and does not mark the easiest case.

issues.problem: Example furigana 十[じゅう]個[こ] was wrong (十個 is read じゅっこ); its English also left out the per-day meaning.
issues.action: Changed to 十[じゅっ]個[こ] and changed the English to 'ten words a day'.

issues.problem: Mistake 'good' sentence 学生に一冊ずつ本を配った had awkward word order.
issues.action: Changed to 学生に本を一冊ずつ配った.
